notes.title: Update: New characters and no purchases!
notes.content:
[b][u]UPDATE (22 April 2019)[/u][/b]
So it's been a while since we updated the game! But you will be pleased to know... we finally did something!

So the time server has been a bit screwy for a while, as has the purchasing server, as a result we have decided to make everything in the game free! You have to find out how to get it all, but yes - we thank you for playing the game! In the lead up to the next election, who knows what will happen!

We also added a new set of characters - these characters are for and against the game - and their dialogue comprises entirely of real customer reviews. Did you say something horrible about the game? Well maybe your review made it in, or did you say something nice... maybe that's there too! We scoured literally thousands of reviews across various platforms to collect up this new content!. 

Thanks for your support, and please consider purchasing one of our other games if you want to help support our company.

notes.title: New updates coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since the game was updated, and the end of the elections. We are happy to say we will be having a new update soon! We will be fixing some issues on our end regarding save files. There will also be 2 new characters!! So stay tuned!

Thank you for all your patience and support so far!

notes.title: Campaign Clicker is out!
notes.content:
With mere weeks until the USA has a new president, we thought it was time to release our game! keep an eye out for updates that include the presidential debates as they happen!

We hope you enjoy the game! and thanks for trying it out,
